literature_notes: Three ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L2 (PMC4968941) describe the construct 'pTRES-hADAM33-SS-PRO-MP-3Flag', whose name explicitly encodes only the Signal Sequence + Prodomain + Metalloprotease domains with a C-terminal 3×Flag. The paper's own terminology ('sADAM33' = soluble ADAM33) and the domain abbreviations confirm this is a secreted ectodomain truncation, not a full-length membrane-anchored protein. It is excluded by the rule against 'a soluble ectodomain or single-domain construct secreted as a separate protein'. L3 (PMC10284970) describes 'ADAM33-N-HA', a C-terminal HA tag on the ADAM33-n isoform used for co-immunoprecipitation in thyroid cancer cells. ADAM33-n is a nuclear/cytoplasmic isoform of ADAM33 that lacks the transmembrane domain; its C-terminal HA tag is therefore intracellular (nuclear), not on the extracellular surface of a membrane-anchored protein. No ledger line reports a tag insertion tolerated at an extracellular position of full-length, membrane-anchored ADAM33. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: ADAM33-n isoform (nuclear/cytoplasmic, lacks TM domain) carries a C-terminal HA tag used for co-IP; the canonical C-terminus (residue 813) is intracellular, and the ADAM33-n isoform C-terminus is likewise intracellular/nuclear — not an extracellular surface position.
